method: 28 targeted authored variants and negative controls. Expectations recorded before this evaluation. Candidates analyzed only, including script fixture contents; no candidate was executed. Not an unbiased accuracy estimate.

expected.name: renamed CTE
expected.command: psql -c 'WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM orders RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM removed'
expected.rationale: Executing a data-modifying CTE can delete all rows, even if its result is not consumed.

expected.name: multiple CTEs
expected.command: psql -c 'WITH harmless AS (SELECT 1), removed AS (DELETE FROM orders RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM removed'
expected.rationale: Executing a data-modifying CTE can delete all rows, even if its result is not consumed.

expected.name: unconsumed modifying CTE
expected.command: psql -c 'WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM orders RETURNING *) SELECT 1 WHERE FALSE'
expected.rationale: Executing a data-modifying CTE can delete all rows, even if its result is not consumed.

expected.name: executed explain CTE
expected.command: psql -c 'EXPLAIN ANALYZE WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM orders RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM removed'
expected.rationale: Executing a data-modifying CTE can delete all rows, even if its result is not consumed.
